title: U.S. Army Reserve Medical Team Provides Needed Healthcare After Hurricane Maria
description: The 335th Medical Support Company steps in to help local citizens of Aguadilla, Puerto Rico. The Buen Samaritano Hospital was so severely damaged by Hurricane Maria that it was unable to receive any patients. Memebers of the 335th MSC responded, not just as Army Reserve soldiers, but as fellow Puerto Rican citizens.
